source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The published article studies generic identification of direct effects in acyclic mixed graphs under general nonlinear confounding and says it explores a feedback-loop generalization.
The exact publication is pp. 2506-2528 and studies identification from higher-order moment/cumulant tensor restrictions together with efficient estimation methods.
For a simple directed cycle with diagonal positive error covariance, the covariance fiber has cardinality at most two and generically equals two.
A diagonal single higher-order cumulant condition identifies the structural matrix up to scaling and permutation by an eigenvector problem and yields a root-n asymptotically normal sample analogue.
Pairwise mean independence yields generic mixing identification, while dropping one mean-independence condition loses generic identifiability.
